articles.title: Trump's green card curbs test Indian tech workers' American dream
articles.summary: Earlier this month, the US announced it would suspend eight technology firms , including Microsoft, India's Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services, Wipro and HCL Technologies, from hiring skilled international workers on a permanent basis through a widely used visa pathway. New and pending applications under the Permanent Labor Certification Program, or PERM, have been frozen.

articles.summary_hi: इस महीने की शुरुआत में, अमेरिका ने घोषणा की कि वह माइक्रोसॉफ्ट, भारत की इंफोसिस, टाटा कंसल्टेंसी सर्विसेज, विप्रो और एचसीएल टेक्नोलॉजीज सहित आठ प्रौद्योगिकी कंपनियों को व्यापक रूप से उपयोग किए जाने वाले वीजा मार्ग के माध्यम से स्थायी आधार पर कुशल अंतरराष्ट्रीय श्रमिकों को काम पर रखने से निलंबित कर देगा। स्थायी श्रम प्रमाणन कार्यक्रम या पीईआरएम के तहत नए और लंबित आवेदनों पर रोक लगा दी गई है।

articles.summary_hinglish: isa mahine ki shuruaata men, amerika ne ghoshana ki ki vaha maikrosopht, bharata ki inphosis, tata kansaltensi sarvisej, vipro aura echasiela teknolojija sahita aatha praudyogiki kanpaniyon ko vyapaka rupa se upayoga kie jane vale vija marga ke madhyama se sthayi aadhara para kushala antararashtriya shramikon ko kama para rakhane se nilanbita kara dega। sthayi shrama pramanana karyakrama ya pieeaaraema ke tahata nae aura lanbita aavedanon para roka laga di gaee hai।

articles.title: Video of Chhattisgarh woman IPS officer firing AK-47 during Dussehra ritual sparks debate
articles.summary: While some social media users defended Rajnandgaon Superintendent of Police (SP) Ankita Sharma saying that she was merely following a tradition, others criticised her handling of the weapon. A traditional 'Shastra Puja' (weapon worship) ritual was performed at Police Lines in Rajnandgaon city on Tuesday on the occasion of Vijayadashami.

articles.title: US Congress delegation meets Dalai Lama in Dharamshala
articles.summary: Representatives Jason Smith, David Schweikert, Elise Stefanik, Laura Friedman and Andy Ogles formed the delegation. Sikyong Penpa Tsering, head of the Central Tibetan Administration (CTA), was present during the meeting, a statement issued here said. The interaction underscored the continued engagement of US lawmakers with the Tibetan leadership and the Tibetan cause.
articles.title_hi: अमेरिकी कांग्रेस प्रतिनिधिमंडल ने धर्मशाला में दलाई लामा से मुलाकात की
articles.summary_hi: प्रतिनिधि जेसन स्मिथ, डेविड श्वेइकर्ट, एलिस स्टेफनिक, लौरा फ्रीडमैन और एंडी ओगल्स ने प्रतिनिधिमंडल का गठन किया। यहां जारी एक बयान में कहा गया कि बैठक के दौरान केंद्रीय तिब्बती प्रशासन (सीटीए) के प्रमुख सिक्योंग पेन्पा त्सेरिंग उपस्थित थे। बातचीत ने तिब्बती नेतृत्व और तिब्बती मुद्दे के साथ अमेरिकी सांसदों की निरंतर भागीदारी को रेखांकित किया।

articles.title: Sensex Jumps Over 1,100 Points as Finance Minister’s Tax Comments Lift Indian Markets
articles.summary: MUMBAI — Indian stock markets rebounded sharply Tuesday, with the benchmark Sensex gaining more than 1,100 points as investors welcomed Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman’s willingness to discuss changes to key market-related taxes. The Sensex surged 1,109. 10 points, or 1. 54%, to close at 73,033. 78, while the Nifty 50 advanced 358.

articles.title: Haryana beat Madhya Pradesh to win Senior Men Hockey National Championship
articles.summary: Mohammad Zaid Khan gave Madhya Pradesh the lead with a field goal in the 14th minute but Haryana equalised in the second quarter when Navraj Singh scored a penalty corner in the 21st. The match stayed level until the 50th minute, when Joginder scored the winner from another penalty corner.

articles.title: Warm weather abroad slows Goa’s charter flow as tourists book late
articles.summary: Goa’s international charter season has started earlier than usual, but tour operators say foreign arrivals are coming in with an unhurried mood. With unusually warm conditions lingering across parts of Europe, Kazakhstan, and other source markets, many travellers seem less compelled by the usual urge to escape a harsh winter.

articles.title: Five Gharoh girls selected for national football championship
articles.summary: Five girls from Government Senior Secondary School, Gharoh, in Kangra district have been selected for the national-level under-19 Girls’ Football Championship following their impressive performance in the state-level tournament. Advertisement The state-level U-19 Girls’ Football Championship was held at Government Senior Secondary School, Manpur Devra, Paonta Sahib, in Sirmaur district, from October 11 to 14.

articles.title: Ranji Trophy: Mumbai Thrash Himachal Pradesh By Innings & 97 Runs
articles.summary: Mumbai registered their second successive bonus-point win in the Ranji Trophy, thrashing Himachal Pradesh by an innings and 97 runs in their Elite Group D clash on Wednesday. After declaring at a mammoth 528/8, powered by Sarfaraz Khan’s 154 and Akash Anand’s 117, Mumbai bowled out the hosts for 291 in their second innings.
articles.title_hi: रणजी ट्रॉफी: मुंबई ने हिमाचल प्रदेश को पारी और 97 रन से हराया

articles.title_hinglish: ranaji trophi: munbaee ne himachala pradesha ko pari aura 97 rana se haraya

articles.title: Critical tech list under review to push self-reliance
articles.summary: India's Niti Aayog is preparing a list of critical technologies for enhancing self-reliance and investment. This initiative aims to protect against disruptions due to limited access to essential technologies. Potential technologies include 6G, defence equipment, and electric vehicle powertrains. The government seeks to encourage innovation through the Anusandhan National Research Foundation and other funds.

articles.title_hinglish: aatmanirbharata ko badhaाva dene ke lie mahatvapurna takaniki suchi ki samiksha ki ja rahi hai
articles.summary_hinglish: bharata ka niti aayoga aatmanirbharata aura nivesha badhaाne ke lie mahatvapurna praudyogikiyon ki eka suchi taiyara kara raha hai। isa pahala ka uddeshya aavashyaka praudyogikiyon taka simita pahuncha ke karana hone vale vyavadhanon se raksha karana hai। sanbhavita praudyogikiyon men 6ji, raksha upakarana aura ilektrika vahana pavaratrena shamila hain। sarakara anusandhana neshanala risarcha phaundeshana aura anya phandon ke madhyama se navachara ko protsahita karana chahati hai।

articles.title: SBI investigates dark web leak of 3.8 lakh records
articles.summary: State Bank of India is currently investigating a suspected data breach involving customer information found online. The breach reportedly exposed around 375,000 records containing personally identifiable information. SBI activated protocols and engaged cybersecurity experts to assess the extent of the breach. Preliminary analysis revealed that 3,897 customer records included sensitive personal data.

articles.title: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio Dismisses Protests in India as Internal Matter
articles.summary: United States Secretary of State Marco Rubio refused to comment on recent protests against the Election Commission in Mumbai on Wednesday, terming the demonstrations an internal political matter. articles.title: Prachi Tokas Guarantees India's First Medal At U-19 World Boxing Championships

articles.title: Ground below Uttarakhand quietly building energy for a mega earthquake: Study
